content.title: These Cape Cod grocery stores are open on Easter (plus, which are closed)
content.text: April 4, 2026, 5:03 a.m. ETNeed to grab some last-minute marshmallow Peeps or eggs to dye on Easter? Did you get that glazed ham?Many grocery stores on Cape Cod will be open on Easter Sunday, but their hours may be limited.While no state laws prevent supermarkets from opening as usual on Easter - like so-called blue laws that prohibit work on Thanksgiving and Christmas - many opt to open with limited hours to allow employees to celebrate the holiday.To avoid any surprises, shoppers should check store hours before heading out to the supermarket on Sunday, April 5.Here's what to know about popular Massachusetts grocery stores on the spring holiday.Is Stop & Shop open on Easter 2026?Most Massachusetts Stop & Shop stores will be open until 5 p.m. on Easter Sunday, the website said. Stop & Shop has 17 locations on the Cape and Islands: East Falmouth, Edgartown (2), Harwich, Hyannis, Marstons Mills, Mashpee, Nantucket (2), Orleans, Provincetown, Sandwich (2), South Dennis, South Yarmouth (2) and Vineyard Haven.Is Market Basket open on Easter 2026?All Market Basket stores will be closed on Easter Sunday. There is a Market Basket in Bourne.Is Shaw's open on Easter 2026?Most Shaw's locations will be open regular business hours on Easter Sunday. There are Shaw's stores in South Yarmouth, Hyannis, Harwich Port, Orleans and East Falmouth.Is Roche Bros. open on Easter 2026?Roche Bros. stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year, according to the company's website. There is a Roche Bros. in Mashpee.Is ALDI open on Easter 2026?ALDI locations will be closed on Easter Sunday. There is an ALDI in Falmouth.Is Whole Foods open on Easter 2026?Many Whole Foods locations are open on Easter Sunday, but with modified hours, the chain's website said. The Hyannis store is open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter.Is Trader Joe's open on Easter 2026?All Trader Joe's stores will be open regular hours on Easter 2026. There is a Trader Joe's in Hyannis.Is Walmart open on Easter 2026?Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter Sunday, according to the company. There is a Walmart in Teaticket.Is Target open on Easter 2026?All Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, according to the company's website. There is a Target in Hyannis.Is BJ's Wholesale Club open on Easter 2026?Most BJ's Wholesale Club locations will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday, according to the company. However, customers should check with their local club to confirm hours. There is a BJ's in Hyannis.
